description.en: Side conversations in the native DSH Web sidebar: fork a turn or start with selected references, keep follow-up messages separate from the main session, and navigate citations back to their source. Uses native composer and session logs; version 0.2.8 tested with unmodified DSH 0.2.1-rc.3.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 原生右侧栏展开侧问：从回合 Fork 或仅带选文新建，追问消息不写回主会话，点击引用可定位原文。复用原生输入框与会话日志；0.2.8 已在未修改的 DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 上测试。
